description: Fiction visuelle : une société habitable vers 2250. Visuels générés avec l’outil imagegen intégré, puis animés et montés hors ligne. Vêtements contemporains de 2026, matières et finitions discrètement adaptées à 2250.

scenes.prompt:

Scene: A flourishing restored mixed woodland with old deciduous trees, young saplings, ferns and moss, photographed at human height. Two forest stewards at a respectful small scale in the middle distance, seen from behind on a modest narrow path, quietly observing the regeneration. A small old fire scar on one moss-covered trunk is barely noticeable among healthy growth. Rich layered native vegetation, leaves softly backlit by diffused morning light. Clear moderate depth of field, no dense fog, no destruction. For the loop junction, fine leafy branches frame both upper side edges, soft sage light in the central clearing.
